# elasticstack_fleet_server_host (Data Source)

Returns a Fleet server host looked up by `host_id`, by `name`, or as the default Fleet server host (`default = true`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Excluded from TestAccExamples_planOnly (planOnlySkippedEmbedPaths): the lookups fail
# unless a matching Fleet server host already exists in Kibana/Fleet, and host names and
# IDs vary by stack. Substitute the name or host_id of your Fleet server host before apply.

provider "elasticstack" {
  kibana {}
}

data "elasticstack_fleet_server_host" "by_name" {
  name = "Fleet"
}

data "elasticstack_fleet_server_host" "by_id" {
  host_id = "fleet-default-fleet-server-host"
}

data "elasticstack_fleet_server_host" "default" {
  default = true
}

resource "elasticstack_fleet_agent_policy" "example" {
  name                 = "example"
  namespace            = "default"
  fleet_server_host_id = data.elasticstack_fleet_server_host.by_name.host_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `default` (Boolean) Set to `true` to look up the default Fleet server host; `false` is not a valid selector. When `host_id` or `name` is the selector, this reports whether the matched host is the default one. Set exactly one of `host_id`, `name` or `default`; the others are populated from the API response.
- `host_id` (String) The identifier of the Fleet server host. Set exactly one of `host_id`, `name` or `default`; the others are populated from the API response.
- `kibana_connection` (Block List) Kibana connection configuration block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--kibana_connection))
- `name` (String) The name of the Fleet server host. Set exactly one of `host_id`, `name` or `default`; the others are populated from the API response.
- `space_id` (String) The Kibana space the Fleet API request is sent through. Fleet server hosts are shared by all spaces, so `space_id` does not filter the lookup. If `space_id` is not provided, the default space is used.

### Read-Only

- `hosts` (List of String) The URLs of the Fleet server host.
- `id` (String) The ID of this Fleet server host.
- `proxy_id` (String) The ID of the Fleet proxy used by this Fleet server host.
- `ssl` (Attributes) TLS configuration Fleet Server presents to Elastic Agents. The private key is not exposed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssl))

<a id="nestedblock--kibana_connection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kibana_connection`

Optional:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API Key to use for authentication to Kibana
- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer Token to use for authentication to Kibana
- `ca_certs` (List of String) A list of paths to CA certificates to validate the certificate presented by the Kibana server.
- `endpoints` (List of String, Sensitive) A comma-separated list of endpoints where the terraform provider will point to, this must include the http(s) schema and port number.
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) A map of headers to be sent with each request to Kibana. Custom header values may appear in provider debug logs: Authorization is masked, but arbitrary custom proxy-token headers are not generally redacted.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Disable TLS certificate validation
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password to use for API authentication to Kibana.
- `username` (String) Username to use for API authentication to Kibana.


<a id="nestedatt--ssl"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssl`

Read-Only:

- `certificate` (String) The TLS certificate Fleet Server presents to Elastic Agents.
- `certificate_authorities` (List of String) Certificate authorities used to validate Elastic Agent client certificates.
- `client_auth` (String) Whether Fleet Server requests client certificates from Elastic Agents: `none`, `optional` or `required`.
